mutations.contract: A browser runner that ends -- by Ctrl-Break, by a throw, by process.exit -- leaves no Chrome running: every Chrome process is signalled (gone) at the instant its node exits, or the runner named it on a BROWSER LEFT RUNNING line; on the throw path the browser exited 0 because the finally CLOSED it rather than the exit handler killing it.
mutations.note: Drops the exit handler, the only thing that can close a browser a process.exit() leaves open. Chrome then dies 50-365 ms later on its own, as its DevTools pipe closes, and Playwright's own exit hook taskkills it silently -- exit code set, but the runner never named it on a BROWSER LEFT RUNNING line, so the witness's verdict is red.
